platePrompt: A cozy artisan mountain cafe interior with warm wooden textures and soft morning light filtering through large windows overlooking misty Himalayan peaks. Hand-thrown ceramic coffee cups on a raw wooden counter, dried wildflowers in a glass jar, warm amber tones mixing with cool mountain blues. Natural linen textures, exposed brick, and hanging Edison bulbs creating intimate warmth. The composition is spacious with generous negative space in the upper right and lower third for text overlay. Soft directional light from the left window. Shot on Hasselblad X2D 100C, 65mm lens, f/2.8, shallow depth of field, warm color grade. Photorealistic, editorial quality, tactile textures.
